A wrongful death malpractice claim involves both the legal system and medical experts: a specialist attorney can help with the estate appointment, deadlines, and review of your father’s care.

Would you like a referral to an attorney? If so, you can use the contact form below this reply. Please seek representation promptly, since some deadlines may be shorter than the two-year wrongful death deadline.

This is general information, not legal advice.
